endorsements.name: Huagang Xie
endorsements.label: Linux Kernel Security with LIDS
endorsements.description: The talk will discuss the backgroup, current architecture and use the LIDS. And also will talk about what kind of attacks LIDS can detect and prevent and finally will get into details how to build a secure linux system with LIDS.
